standard-dialogue.npc: Beyond this wall you'll find the Kebos Lowlands. Most of the region is lizardman territory. We're here to keep them from entering Kourend.
We used to keep this passage properly barricaded shut, but then the fancy historians from the Arceuus Library wanted to go do some research out there.
Soon the farmers joined them, and before you knew it, everyone wanted to go explore. Some of them have even started living out there.
I can see it all ending badly, but that's the problem with intellectuals - they always think they know better.
Anyway, maybe they'll all get themselves killed. Then we can put the barricade back up.
If you go out there yourself, give the lizardmen a kicking from me. They've killed too many of my soldiers.

prior-to-the-release-of-chambers-of-xeri.npc: Beyond these walls is a Lizardman settlement, we're defending against it.
Who knows, all I know is offence is the best type of defence, we will attack soon, will you help us, brave warrior?
Oh, the assault is not for a while, go train and prepare, for there will be all sorts of grand rewards from this expedition.

prior-to-the-release-of-chambers-of-xeri.player: Rewards? I'm in! Hopefully some brand new armour or something.
